correctness.rationale: Stern recursions give children L(a,b,t)=(a,a+b,t) and R(a,b,t)=(a+b,b,t+1) on primitive residue pairs times Z/h. Elementary unipotents generate SL2(Z/m), transitively on primitive pairs. The exact braid identity L R^{-1} L = R^{-1} L R^{-1} on vector coordinates has digital increments -1 versus -2; composing them supplies a pure t-translation. Thus lifted permutation action is transitive even when gcd(m,h)>1. Both moves are permutations; the directed two-move chain is irreducible and has an L-self-loop at (0,1,t), so is aperiodic. Finite Perron–Frobenius mixing yields uniform mass 1/(h J_2(m)) with exponential rate in binary depth, and binary-prefix subtree decomposition yields O(X^(1-delta)) for all X>=2. Independent bounded BFS verified full reachability for all 55 modulus pairs 2<=m<=12,2<=h<=6; this is corroboration, not proof for arbitrary m,h. Primitive pairs only, no nonprimitive exceptions.
